thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 10/19/2018: SREV, AKTS, IQ, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/19/2018: SREV, AKTS, IQ, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
CSCO: -0.02%
GOOG: +0.55%
Technology stocks were mixed in recent trading, with tech stocks in the S&P 500 climbing 0.7% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was down by 1.7%.
Stocks moving on news include:
(-) ServiceSource International ( SREV ), which was more than 45% lower after pegging Q3 revenue of about $57 million, compared with its previous guidance of $60 million to $61 million. The Street view is for revenue of $60.52 million.
In other sector news:
(-) Akoustis Technologies ( AKTS ) was slipping lower by 17%, after it unveiled plans to sell shares, including an over-allotment option, and $10 million of 6.5% convertible senior notes due 2023.
(-) iQIYI ( IQ ) was down by more than 3%, reversing an earlier gain, as it presented a preview of its 2019 programming, unveiling more than 200 new shows including dramas, movies, variety shows, animation, comics and live streaming programs.
